moments.title: Spain Crowned World Cup Champions
moments.blurb: Spain defeated Argentina 1-0 in extra time on July 19, 2026, to win their second FIFA World Cup title in a thrilling final held in New York/New Jersey.

angles.name: Final Recap
angles.copy: Still buzzing from the World Cup final? Spain made history last Sunday, clinching their second title against Argentina in an extra-time thriller. What a game! #WorldCup2026

angles.name: Spain's Victory
angles.copy: Ferran Torres, the hero! Spain are World Cup champions once again after a nail-biting 1-0 win over Argentina. Relive the moments that mattered.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the Official UK Singles Chart No. 1 for its 18th non-consecutive week, tying an all-time record.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: It's 18 weeks at Number 1 for Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In'! An incredible run on the Official UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: Record Breaker
angles.copy: History made! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean just tied the record for most non-consecutive weeks at UK No.1. Unstoppable!
